name: no-input-default
description: Input on L0 and L1 stops after 300ms and the trace runs on for another 2s, crossing the resolver's 1000ms staleness threshold. With no_input_behavior = default, the value falls back to the link's static_value (None here, so 0). Frequency (linked to L1) shows the effect directly in the B0 period bytes; intensity is on the engine path, which holds via the V2 ramp regardless of this setting.
